fields.calculatedFormula:
CASE(
    TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey),

    /* ---------------- ENGLISH ---------------- */
    "en_US",
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c),
        IMAGE("/img/x.gif", "Not invoiced") & " Invoice not received",

        IF(
            NOT(ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c)) &&
            ISPICKVAL(FacturaProveedorPagada__c, "No") &&
            (ETD__c >= TODAY()),
            IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Pending") &
            " Pending. " & TEXT(ETD__c - TODAY()) & " day(s) before ETD",

            IF(
                NOT(ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c)) &&
                ISPICKVAL(FacturaProveedorPagada__c, "No") &&
                (ETD__c < TODAY()),
                IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Pending") &
                " Pending. " & TEXT(TODAY() - ETD__c) & " day(s) after ETD",

                IF(
                    NOT(ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c)) &&
                    ISPICKVAL(FacturaProveedorPagada__c, "Sí"),
                    IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Paid") & " Paid",
                    "Unable to determine indicator"
                )
            )
        )
    ),

    /* ---------------- SPANISH (DEFAULT) ---------------- */
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c),
        IMAGE("/img/x.gif", "Sin facturar") & " Factura no recibida",

        IF(
            NOT(ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c)) &&
            ISPICKVAL(FacturaProveedorPagada__c, "No") &&
            (ETD__c >= TODAY()),
            IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Pendiente") &
            " Pendiente. A " & TEXT(ETD__c - TODAY()) & " día(s) del ETD",

            IF(
                NOT(ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c)) &&
                ISPICKVAL(FacturaProveedorPagada__c, "No") &&
                (ETD__c < TODAY()),
                IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Pendiente") &
                " Pendiente. " & TEXT(TODAY() - ETD__c) & " día(s) después del ETD",

                IF(
                    NOT(ISBLANK(Numero_de_Factura_Proveedor__c)) &&
                    ISPICKVAL(FacturaProveedorPagada__c, "Sí"),
                    IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Pagado") & " Pagado",
                    "No es posible definir el indicador"
                )
            )
        )
    )
)

        diseno_a_fabrica__c,
        IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Completed") & " Completed",

            ISBLANK(Fecha_limite_de_aprobacion_de_Packaging__c),
            IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "Missing Deadline") & " Deadline Pending",
            
            IF(
                Fecha_limite_de_aprobacion_de_Packaging__c - TODAY() <= 0,
                IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/error16.png", "Deadline Exceeded") & " Deadline Exceeded",

                    IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Packaging Pending") &
                    " " & TEXT(Fecha_limite_de_aprobacion_de_Packaging__c - TODAY()) & " days left"
                )
            )
        )
    ),

    /* ---------------- SPANISH (DEFAULT) ---------------- */
    IF(
        diseno_a_fabrica__c,
        IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Concluido") & " Concluido",
        
        IF(
            ISBLANK(Fecha_limite_de_aprobacion_de_Packaging__c),
